titre: He took a free knight. Look what happens. ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Anderssen vs Dufresne, Berlin 1852, the Evergreen Game. Black grabs a knight and threatens mate, but Anderssen sacrifices a rook, then his queen, and mates with the bishops. Would you have sacrificed the queen? 👇
